localBiteReport: The most recent detailed inshore report for Choctawhatchee Bay is from the week of October 23–29, 2026 — roughly two weeks ago. According to Capt. Blake Nelson of Last Cast Charters, the redfish bite on the Choctawhatchee Bay flats held up well despite a recent storm, with smaller slot reds (around 23 inches and under) still working familiar guts, potholes, and shallow feeding areas. Nelson noted that fall redfish in the bay have been keying on small shrimp, tiny crabs, and worms rather than chasing visible baitfish schools, making subtle bottom-oriented presentations — including a Ned rig — particularly effective. A charter review on FishingBooker also noted a recent keeper redfish catch on a bay and bridge trip in this area. Water temperature at this location is currently 74°F.
